source: V20 Dark Ages (VtDA20), pp. 188-316. Codes and short summaries; read the page for the full system.

abyss.ritual: Occult 3+, level capped by Obtenebration or Occult; +1 difficulty without an Occult specialty (p. 270)

lesser.Thaumaturgy: Creatio Ignis: one success reaches 10 yards, each more adds 10; Perception + Alertness to hit. A botch spills the flame or burns the caster.
lesser.Thaumaturgy: Iter Pernix: each success is an hour on the road at about 45 km/h with no fatigue; no effect in combat. A botch makes mounts balk (half speed or off course).
lesser.Thaumaturgy: Potestas Motus: a turn of control per success, renewed with another roll; five successes hold it for the scene. A botch roots the caster's feet for a turn (no dodging).
lesser.Thaumaturgy: Potestas Tempestatum: successes set how fast it comes (one is a day's drift, five is at once); a scene per success; +2 difficulty indoors, where only fog, wind and temperature work. A botch angers local spirits.
lesser.note: A lesser path grows one power's force with each dot, not new powers (VtDA20 p. 297).

dark.power: b1, Willpower at level + 3; a botch costs a permanent Willpower point (DAC 2002 p. 105)
dark.maleficia: A target who knows they are afflicted and faces the infernalist may roll Wits + Occult at the infernalist's Willpower to turn it back; a botch turns it on the caster; the Church's exorcism or blessing lifts a curse; all end if the infernalist dies (DAC 2002 p. 109)
dark.manes: Rego Manes also wounds any spirit at once with a few words: roll the path rating as damage, resisted by Willpower. A called demon stays until sunrise or church bells (DAC 2002 pp. 107-108).

powers.e: Senses predators nearby (Cainites, shapeshifters, ghosts, killers) for the scene.
One turn to grow a predator's trait: claws (Strength +1 lethal), a tail, keen senses and the like.
Sinks into a sleep just short of torpor, hidden from senses and Auspex.
Takes on a darkness-born trait for the scene; Rötschreck is +1 difficulty meanwhile.
Becomes a chosen predator animal; the form must be learned in advance.
Speaks with an animal after eye contact; no roll.
Calls animals of a named kind; more successes, more come.
Cows or soothes a creature's Beast; a mortal loses Willpower drive, a vampire can't frenzy for the scene.
Possesses an animal after eye contact; mental Disciplines work through it as successes allow.
Forces their Beast into another after eye contact: frenzy or worse in the target, calm in themself.
Sharpens a sense: its rolls are at −Auspex difficulty. Sudden glare or noise can stun.
Reads a subject's aura: mood, then nature of being (vampire, mage...) with more successes.
Reads impressions from a touched object; older, weaker traces are harder (4 to 9).
Sends or reads thoughts; one success to send, more to read deeper.
Projects the mind out of the body, travelling invisibly; the body lies helpless.
Within a week of losing a Humanity dot, rolls to regain it without experience.
A mystic 'dodge': successes cancel a supernatural attack's successes.
Animal blood nourishes fully; an animal holds blood equal to its health levels.
A night-long rite consecrates a place where violence and frenzy are hard.
Speaks words that strip a listener of their Beast's influence for the scene.
A stationary illusion of one sense, about 7 cubic metres per dot.
An illusion for all senses, still or moving as chosen at creation.
Animates an existing illusion while the vampire concentrates.
An illusion lasts until dismissed.
An illusion one victim believes real: it can hurt them (lethal levels by successes).
Learns a subject's moral weakness or Virtue shortfall.
Mocking a known fear makes the target flee or freeze; vampires test Rötschreck.
Hurls a bolt of infernal flame: aggravated damage.
After Sense the Sin, the target rolls their lowest Virtue (vs the Baali's Willpower) or their derangements erupt.
A lasting curse; successes set its length (a week up to permanent).
Inflames one emotion in the target; successes extend it.
After three turns of talk, the victim is plagued by sights and sounds for nights by successes.
Reads the hidden pattern in a person, court or event.
A stronger Soul Haunting that can drive one or several into madness for the scene.
Strips a target's sanity, granting a temporary derangement.
A one-word command, obeyed at once after eye contact.
Implants a complex instruction; successes set how well it holds.
Removes or rewrites memories; more successes, deeper changes.
Extended: 5 to 10 × the subject's Self-Control/Instinct successes make them pliant.
After a clash of wills (subject rolls Willpower, 7), takes over a mortal's body.
Knows when someone deliberately lies; no roll.
Sees fae and the fae-touched truly, and senses faerie magic.
Absorbs an object's impressions, erasing them as they are learned.
A ward symbol that bars or hurts a named fae, object or person.
Poses a riddle the victim can do nothing but ponder until solved.
A zone of total silence around them, up to 20 feet.
Unnoticed while still and quiet; drawing attention breaks it.
Seen as someone else; copying a real face needs a good look.
Disappears even while watched; contested by the highest Wits + Alertness.
Extends an Obfuscate power to one more person per dot of Stealth.
+1 die to Intimidation and Stealth; shapes nearby shadows.
A 10-foot cloud of utter darkness; those inside fight blind and may falter.
One 6-foot shadow tentacle per success that grapples and crushes.
Shadow images, one per success, or one larger one.
Three turns to become living shadow: immune to most physical harm, can't touch or be touched.
A sacrificial rite seeds an area with slumbering plants that hinder intruders (−2 to all pools).
A sacrificed warrior's head gives them wound immunity and fighting edges for a scene.
A curse laid through the sacrifice of the target's friend or kin.
A wicker-man rite over three nights; a great blessing of war.
A sacrifice on a dolmen opens a draught of power and blood.
Projects one simple impression to everyone around: social rolls helped.
Terrifies a target: cowed, fleeing or frozen by successes.
Bends a subject's emotions: they want to serve the vampire, from hours to months by successes.
Calls someone the vampire has met to come to them, as fast and as willingly as successes allow.
No roll: anyone who would act against them rolls Courage (vs their Charisma + Intimidation) or can't.
Sees in darkness; ignores blind-fighting penalties; eyes glow red.
Claws: Strength +1 aggravated damage.
Sinks into bare earth and rests there, safe from the sun.
Becomes a wolf or bat over three turns (extra blood speeds it).
Becomes mist over three turns; immune to most physical harm.
Drains a victim nearly dry to learn and keep the gist of their knowledge.
Turns blood to poison (up to the per-turn limit); a hit reduces Stamina by successes.
After their blood enters the target, wracks them from afar: lethal damage by successes.
Blood on a blade or claws as poison: aggravated wounds.
After feeding on mortal blood, each success makes a point count double.
Hardens or preserves an object with their blood.
With a point of the target's blood in a vessel, knows when they lie.
A blood baptism that can wash away a blood bond or Dominate.
Imprints an emotion in a subject's blood; whoever drinks it feels it.
Through a drop of the target's vitae, makes them sweat blood points away.
−1 difficulty on Social rolls; a gaze can freeze one target in place.
A forked tongue lash: Strength aggravated damage, an extra attack.
Scaled skin: soak difficulty 5, Stamina soaks aggravated (not fire or sun).
Becomes a great serpent over three turns (blood speeds it).
Births a serpent-beast from their own flesh; a health level stays marked while it lives.
Bargains with an object's spirit for bonus dice on one kind of task.
A spirit animal takes form; successes set how long it stays.
Takes on one animal trait for a turn per success.
Devours a spirit: a Willpower point per success.
Strength +3, Dexterity and Stamina +2; Appearance and Manipulation fall.
Knows the exact time and how long has passed.
Reflexively freezes a moment to think: extra time to plan or defend.
Slows a target's actions; harder against faster beings.
Leaden Movement on several targets (a blood point each).
Extra actions in a turn by successes, ignoring the blood limit.
Reads health, wounds, blood and whether a subject is living or undead.
A touch blocks pain (wound penalties ignored) or puts someone to sleep.
Heals a touched creature: a blood point per lethal level, two per aggravated.
A barrier of force around them and those they shield.
Cleanses a soul of derangement or the Beast's weight; can restore Road.
Like Sense Vitality, but for death and the dead.
Like Gift of Sleep: dulls their own wound penalties or knocks a foe out.
A grasp that burns: aggravated damage per blood point.
Armor 1 per success (up to five), glowing red.
A hand over the heart kills peacefully; costly for their Road.
Senses a person or event that will matter to their fate.
A touched foe is +2 difficulty to strike them for three turns.
Smeared blood makes the victim shunned by all.
An aura in one chamber where violence falters.
Draws out a victim's soul with a breath.
Reshapes their own face and body (a blood point per change).
Reshapes another's flesh after subduing them.
Reshapes bone; as an attack, aggravated damage.
War-form: Physical Attributes +3, Social 0, claws.
Gives a severed part of their body a life of its own.
Gazes into a ball of shadow to scry the Abyss.
Crushing a flame (an aggravated level, a Rötschreck test), sees through darkness.
Draws the Abyss into their flesh after a turn of meditation.
A night-long summoning of a shade from the Abyss.

powers.n: The Third Eye of Abyssal Sight
powers.e: Sees what hides in shadow and darkness.
A contracted Nocturne shows distant places.
Speaks through the darkness to those far away.
Adds its dots to Initiative and to yards moved a turn; a blood point lets them ignore multiple-action penalties for up to their Celerity in actions (half may be attacks).
Adds its dots to Initiative and to yards moved a turn; a blood point lets them ignore multiple-action penalties for up to their Celerity in actions (half may be attacks).

Adds its dots to Initiative and to yards moved a turn; a blood point lets them ignore multiple-action penalties for up to their Celerity in actions (half may be attacks).
Adds its dots to Stamina pools and to bashing and lethal soak; its dice soak aggravated damage; once a turn a blood point soaks their Fortitude automatically.
Adds its dots to Stamina pools and to bashing and lethal soak; its dice soak aggravated damage; once a turn a blood point soaks their Fortitude automatically.

Adds its dots to Strength pools; for one turn, spending a blood point makes each of those dice an automatic success (damage too).
Adds its dots to Strength pools; for one turn, spending a blood point makes each of those dice an automatic success (damage too).

Adds its dots to Strength pools; for one turn, spending a blood point makes each of those dice an automatic success (damage too).

Becomes living darkness: winged (flies 25 mph), burrowing (through earth and stone) or brutish (+1 lethal brawling). Physicals +3, Socials 0, Perception and Stealth 2 easier; Strength + 2 aggravated poison bites.
Always on: each blood point drunk from an animal counts as two. Every third animal feeding makes Self-Control/Instinct rolls 1 harder (it adds up) until the vampire feeds on a human or Cainite again.

Touches an animal to share minds, a Willpower point a turn. A full bond takes 10 turns minus successes and a frenzy test; then the vampire uses its senses from anywhere and Animalism on it is 2 easier.
Always on: talks with every animal of one chosen family at a time (dogs and wolves, say) with no roll and no eye contact.
Unleash the Beast on many at once, no eye contact, difficulty 5 + targets. Infected Cainites resist frenzy at +2, mortals frenzy like Cainites, and the vampire's Disciplines on them are 1 easier.

A Willpower point drops the vampire into frenzy at will, no roll. Ending it takes another Willpower point and a Self-Control/Instinct roll at whatever difficulty the present provocation would set (at least 4).

Primes the Beast for the scene: the first brawl or melee blow taken unleashes it on the attacker with the activation successes; if lethal damage got through, the attacker's frenzy rolls are also 2 harder.

Animals within a mile per success swarm to obey rough orders. The swarm's attack pool starts at 2 and grows 2 a turn for turns equal to successes, for 3 + successes bashing; Perception inside is 2 harder.
Spies on a familiar person and their surroundings from afar for a turn per success while staying aware of their own body; other Auspex powers work through it.
Reads what a partner longs to hear: each success adds a die to, or takes 1 off the difficulty (to 4) of, the next mundane Social action against them. No help to Social Disciplines.

Hours of meditation in touch with a person, thing or place; five successes (a person's Willpower dots) bind it. Auspex then reaches it at any range, 2 easier. Difficulty 7 or their Willpower if higher.

Reads an opponent's next move: Perception + the Ability they are using, against their Manipulation + that Ability; each success is a bonus die on the vampire's next action. Works in games and contests of wit too.
Always on: wound penalties turn into bonus dice. It does not let the vampire act while Incapacitated, but each wound taken there gives back a Willpower point.

A touch sends others into Soul's Flight; the willing pay their own Willpower. Forcing the unwilling costs a Willpower point a turn, rolled against their Willpower until successes reach their Willpower dots.
For the scene, runs the first four Auspex powers on everyone nearby at once; any that need a roll use one Perception + Awareness roll compared against each subject.

Touch or eye contact, resisted by Willpower: one blood on a mortal, three blood and a Willpower point on others. Net successes strip Willpower (1, 3, 6, all) and wound; at five the victim passes Willpower (7) or dies.
In torpor, the elder roams as in Soul's Flight but cannot wake the body early. If the cord is cut, they drift back over a year and a day, and the body stays asleep until then.
A kiss and a Willpower point: on a Road of Humanity roll, a mortal cannot be Embraced for a month per success, or ever for a Willpower dot. Hurting them raises degeneration difficulty by 3.
Two blood, reflexively: Celerity dots join one Strength roll as extra dice; an attack made this way also knocks the target down.
One blood: Celerity dots become automatic successes on one roll of fine handwork instead of extra dice.
One blood and a chosen cut to Celerity for the turn: a thrown weapon that hits gains that many automatic damage successes.
Four blood: for the rest of the turn, Celerity counts as automatic successes on every Dexterity roll, extra actions too, instead of dice.
With Celerity active, a blood point buys one more action this turn; 3, 6, 10 and 15 blood buy up to five. Each extra action costs a level of unsoakable lethal damage.

Five blood a turn: moves at full speed in any direction, up walls, over water, through stone unharmed. Passing through someone is a Dexterity + Athletics attack (dodge only) filling their health with lethal.
Three blood, reflexively, even after an attack is rolled but before damage: everything halts while the vampire moves their full speed, in place of a defense, so the attack nearly always misses.
Always on: the first three Chimerstry powers cost nothing, up to Intelligence illusions move without close focus, and they last while within Willpower in miles.
Horrid Reality on a crowd: one roll checked against each target's Perception + Self-Control/Instinct, costing two Willpower plus a blood point per target.

A Willpower point and a blood per die make an illusory blade for the scene: Strength plus those dice, aggravated, at most a die above a real blade. A blood point reforms it if dropped; its wounds stay.
Casts Chimerstry into a place the vampire can see or picture: difficulty 6 for one as known as their haven, up to 9 for one known only from a description. Success lets other Chimerstry work there.

For the scene, real things or people seem unreal and witnesses dismiss them as visions: one object at one success, a person at two, a small group at three, a whole crowd at five. Auspex may see through it.

Lifelike everyday illusions that vanish when the victim reacts, a night per success (1 harder if they have a derangement). Each night costs them a Willpower point, or brings a derangement once they have none.

Scrambles the senses: each success takes a point of Perception; at zero the victim can only wait. One victim (their Willpower) a week to for good by successes; all in sight (difficulty 7) until sunrise.

Five blood and a Willpower point remake reality nearby for a scene: dull blades at one success, swap things at two, solid or insubstantial at three, unmake matter at six. On a person, 2 aggravated a success.

Bought more than once, each time a new infernal gift agreed with the Storyteller: fire immunity, wings, a demon form, a link to Hell, a chained Beast. It never beats faith, sunlight or the need for blood.
Hell's tongue, a Willpower point per roll until successes reach the victim's Willpower dots: they lose a Road dot, and while it stays lost the vampire's Mental and Social rolls on them are 1 easier.

A touch and five blood, beating Stamina + Fortitude: a contagious plague that blocks healing and deals an unsoakable aggravated level daily unless Stamina succeeds, until successes reach the Daimonion dots.

A Willpower point and blood summon a demon of one deadly sin, each blood past the first adding a dot to an Attribute or Willpower. It serves a night (more if Willpower is not regained); one at a time.

powers.n: Call Forth the Herald of Hell
powers.e: Five blood tear a gate: each success costs an unsoakable aggravated level, then a die at or under the successes lets a demon prince through to ravage all. Mortals who see it lose Willpower dots each turn.

A scream, a Willpower point and three blood per turn: a Cainite in sight burns as under the noon sun and faces Rötschreck, for at most a turn per success. Against True Faith it rebounds on the caster.
The Methuselah dies as an unstoppable horror tears out of their body; it ravages the land for a minute per Road dot, then reality forces it back. It has no stats: it is a story event.
Malkavians only: names a Malkavian of the same or weaker blood and talks with them mind to mind while in range, though each must speak as if side by side, shouting over any din around them.

Plants a chosen derangement for good; the victim may spend Willpower one for one to cancel successes. It cannot be ignored with Willpower and ends only with a change of Road. Once per story on any victim.

With eye contact, successes at least equal to the target's Self-Control/Instinct rewrite one of their Virtues; they test degeneration nightly down to Road 3. A botch changes one of the caster's Virtues.

Eye contact and a Willpower point twist a truth the victim holds into a lie they wholly believe, a turn to a year by successes. Proof against it deals an aggravated level a turn; for Cainites, frenzy at +3.
Vitae smeared on the victim and a turn of eye contact, against their Wits + Courage (8): their mind is locked in a dream world a week to decades by successes; Cainites fall into torpor.

A hand on the face and a Willpower point clear every derangement and outside hold on the mind; the target regains all Willpower and gets +1 Mental die for a week. Or the madness is buried until a set time.
Punishes a thrall with pain: a turn per success of helpless agony, each turn an unsoakable bashing level.
Always on: Dominate works through a brief touch of skin on skin instead of eye contact.
Always on: anyone else trying to command, coerce or Dominate the vampire's thralls is 3 harder; at 10 or more it cannot be done.
Rolls a Dominate power against the hardest target in a group (only they need eye contact); each success spreads it to one more person nearby.

Names a body function and stops or alters it for a turn per success; past difficulty 10 it fails. A stopped heart kills a mortal but barely troubles a vampire; it works on other supernatural beings too.
Reaches anyone the vampire knows, at any distance: on success, any Dominate power works as if eye contact were made. A supernatural target costs a second Willpower point.
A permanent Willpower point sends a slow, subtle command down the bloodline over decades; difficulty 4 plus the generations it passes, each step past 10 needing an extra success. Works from torpor.
For the scene, a weapon whose damage is soaked to nothing breaks, and unarmed attackers take the soak successes as bashing damage.

A blood mark on the forehead, a Willpower point and a blood per Fortitude dot given (up to the vampire's own): the subject's Fortitude becomes that, even past their limit, a turn to forever by successes.

For the scene, ordinary heat, blades and blows cannot hurt outside combat (flame still does), metal can be worked by hand, unarmed hits do Strength + Fortitude bashing, and bare hands can block any attack.

Takes a target's mind: all their thoughts and memories open to the Kiasyd while they lose their Knowledges, ten minutes to a month by successes. Harm returns it; if the victim dies first, the memories stay.
The aura turns plain and the Beast hides: to every sense and power the vampire seems an ordinary human, and anything aimed at the Beast (such as Song of Serenity) fails.

One blood. Meditating: a Willpower point back every 15 minutes, then Mental and Willpower rolls 1 easier that night. On a foe (vs Willpower): each success locks out a Dexterity or Mental die for the scene.

Mask of a Thousand Faces as someone the target deeply feels for, living or dead: each success adds two dice to the vampire's Social rolls on them and makes theirs toward the vampire 2 harder, for the scene.

From total seclusion, a Willpower dot erases the vampire from memory: one success blurs those who knew them, two shifts their deeds onto others, three wipes records, four leaves no trace but what they choose to show.

Inner darkness engulfs a target, draining two blood a turn (Stamina 6 resists each turn); anyone with less Courage than the successes flees or faces Rötschreck. Called back, it brings the drained blood.

Steps through one person-sized shadow and out of another in sight, or reaches through to grab (Intelligence + Brawl). Then Courage at 5 (7 if pulled through unwilling) or Rötschreck; a botch strands them.
Frees a person's shadow for an hour per success (dawn ends it): half their traits, half the caster's Obtenebration, up to 50 feet away, half damage. If it dies, its owner loses half their Willpower.
One blood and a contested roll against Dexterity + Occult (both 7) hang a victim in the Abyss: mortals suffocate in Stamina minutes, vampires hang helpless. Sunlight or the caster ends it.

Two Willpower and three turns of focus open a void: all inside take a level per success outright (aggravated for vampires). It takes the dead and mortals at one level; each taken alive gives a Willpower point.
For the scene, any hit on an object destroys it outright; aimed at a foe's weapon or armor, it breaks that instead of wounding them.
Always on unless willed off: unarmed blows do lethal damage and can only be dodged, never blocked or parried.

Three blood on an attack, leaving Potence off the damage: if it wounds after soak, the target later takes Potence in lethal levels at a moment the vampire names within 24 hours. One stored blow at a time.

Lends a target in sight and earshot the vampire's grace for the scene: dice equal to Presence on their Social rolls, and 1 off the difficulty per two successes. Difficulty 5 if the two know each other well.
The victim feels bound to the vampire as by a blood oath for the scene, and each success takes a die from their Social rolls against them. It can be renewed in later scenes the same night.

Eye contact freezes the victim in whimpering terror, three turns up to a week by successes. A real threat to their life allows a Courage roll (difficulty the vampire's Intimidation + 3) to break free.

Flares tempers in those nearest: 2, 4, 8, 20 or everyone around by successes. Affected vampires spend Willpower or roll Self-Control/Instinct against the user's pool or frenzy; a botch frenzies the user.
Makes 2, 4, 8, 20 or everyone nearby (by successes) friendlier to one another for the scene, a Willpower point stretching it longer. Frenzy from insults within the group is 3 easier to resist.
Always on: mortals cannot spend Willpower against the vampire's Presence. Others first roll Willpower (vampire's Willpower + 2); their successes cap what they may spend against it that night.
Casts one emotion over a whole city or region the vampire knows: a minute to a week by successes for residents, one step less for visitors and supernatural beings. Works even from torpor.
One blood and a turn: nothing in the surroundings but sun and fire can harm or hinder the vampire, weather, heat, cold, falls and disasters included.
Always on while in the earth: moves through soil or any natural material at half walking pace, at no extra cost, sensing everything within 50 yards.
A Willpower point on taking mist form keeps it through the day's sleep, safe from all but fire and sunlight.
Three blood, reflexively: skin turns to stone and halves physical damage pools against the vampire; fire, sunlight and supernatural aggravated harm still cut through.

After feeding, takes the last victim's looks (no skills or powers), hiding all signs of being Cainite if it was a human or beast. Two blood and two turns, or three blood for one; it lasts until changed back.
A touch (even as part of an attack) forces a shapeshifter into their true form and keeps them there a turn per success.
In torpor and unwatched, creeps along like a worm, a yard an hour at most, even by day.

A giant beast form in three turns, until sunrise: seven extra Physical dots, Strength + 2 aggravated claws, a Bruised level more, double running speed, keen senses. Frenzy is 2 harder and Willpower cannot stop it.
Turns insubstantial at once while still looking solid: walks through walls, ignores gravity, cannot touch things, takes no physical harm and soaks fire and sunlight with double dice.
One success pushes every foreign object out of the body, stakes included; a Willpower point keeps chosen items in.
Final Death is not final: after nights equal to Generation, the ashes reform as a new body one Generation higher, recalling little but the killer. Traits over the new cap are lost; this power stays.
Like Baal's Caress at 7, two blood per point: a sticky sap that eats wood in a turn, metal in two, stone in three. It burns a turn per success, damage equal to successes then one less each turn.

Always on: drinks through the skin from any blood or bare flesh it touches, at most two points a turn whatever the Generation. Victims resist this Kiss more easily: vampires at 6, mortals at 8 as if Cainite.

Reflexively, one blood and half the pool make all the vampire's vitae a toxin with every Cruscitus effect for the scene: piercing blades corrode, natural weapons take two aggravated, wounding attackers get splashed.

If the vampire's blood ever entered the victim, contested Willpower (harder by their Fortitude) raises their Generation by the net successes; after 10 minus Stamina + Fortitude nights it returns, a step a night.

After drinking a blood point from someone, reads memories in it: vague recent hours at one success, everything they ever knew at six. Perception is 2 harder meanwhile; a botch stuns until blood is spent.

Reflexively locks up to 5 blood (difficulty 5 + points) into clots that stop bleeding or feeding. Or, with touch or shared blood, a Willpower point and Manipulation + Medicine seize a target's blood for turns.

With the victim's fresh blood, they relive the terror of all they fed on: stunned two turns per success, losing 2 blood a turn. After, Courage and Self-Control/Instinct (8) or Rötschreck and a derangement.

The turn after a lesser Hematus power hits a Cainite, a Willpower dot and blood equal to the difficulty (4 plus one per generation reached, max 10) spread that same effect through their line of descendants.
Two blood grow two more heads, each with its own full action a turn (bites, gaze powers; Typhon's Maw applies). The vampire also sees ghosts, and the heads can touch them as if solid.
Three blood and a turn take a god's form fixed when bought: Serpentis dots spread among Attributes (at most half on one), even past Generation limits, plus one effect agreed with the Storyteller.
Hollow fangs: each bite adds Serpentis in lethal damage, and humans who live are paralyzed (-5 to all actions) and roll Stamina every 30 seconds for five minutes or die.

Two blood a turn: a storm 3 yards across per Serpentis dot, half speed, immune to physical harm. All inside take Serpentis bashing each turn; a blood point throws lightning (Perception + Occult), Serpentis aggravated.

One blood and a Willpower point merge with a spirit animal: Intelligence -2, Wits -1, but sunlight cannot harm, staying awake costs 2 Willpower a day, and the Umbra is open. Changing back costs the same.

A touch and a turn's focus age or restore a target a week up to centuries by successes. Each success used comes back as unsoakable lethal damage, rolled against Temporis. It changes wear, not memories or powers.

Halts time a turn per success (one if reflexive) for the vampire and up to Wits passengers; no Disciplines, and frozen foes cannot defend. After, a die per passenger per turn at Temporis: each success is aggravated.
Five blood carry a ballroom-sized sphere back a week to centuries by successes; those inside watch unseen. A Willpower dot brings one thing or person forward if history does not need them.
Against a Cainite in sight, contested by their Willpower (9): each success clots a blood point they cannot use for anything until they spend a Willpower point per point to free it.
Always on: Gift of Sleep and Healer's Touch work at line of sight instead of touch, and Gift of Sleep can turn wound penalties into bonus dice while it lasts.

Music aimed at one task (healing, battle, talks): each success takes 1 off listeners' relevant rolls for the scene, a Willpower point per three listeners. Failure makes them 1 harder; a botch 2 and a lethal level.
Two Willpower and five blood revive someone dead under a week (not of age, soul intact, head mostly whole): the soul returns, the body heals, and they become a revenant. It cannot undo the Embrace.

Three blood, against a foe who has struck the Salubri: one melee or brawl attack counts as if every die of the pool (Celerity included) hit, with two more damage dice, and armor counts half. Once a turn.

Eye contact and contested Willpower pull a target into a dream duel lasting a turn outside: Manipulation for Strength, Charisma for Dexterity, damage to Willpower. At 0 the loser is comatose or in torpor.
Burning Touch no longer ends after a turn: after the first touch it keeps working at range under the third eye, and each blood spent also takes a die from the victim's Rötschreck resistance.

Free once a chapter; then three Willpower, five blood and a sung prayer. For the scene: Physicals at the Generation maximum, a blazing halo (no Stealth, attacks on them 2 harder), immune to mental Disciplines.

Always on: hospitality anywhere, and those hunting the Salubri with ill intent lose 2 dice; a chance sighting calls for contested Willpower (6), and if the Salubri wins the hunter loses interest for the scene.
Pariah's Caress works at line of sight: the target's Social difficulties rise by 2 (to 9), and any Social botch comes across as an insult or threat that may start a fight.

Contested Willpower against a spirit or demon until one side leads by three. A win expels and calms it; another Willpower point puts it in a person, beast, place or the Salubri, serving as if blood bound.
Swaps the souls of two people in sight: their Roads and ratings, Virtues and Natures trade places at once. Two Healers using Unburden the Bestial Soul can undo it.

Three blood for a zulo form with bat wings: flies at 25 mph carrying what two hands could, hearing 2 easier, sight 1 harder, +2 Intimidation. Strength + Body Crafts (7) grows Strength + 2 aggravated claws.

Always on: the vampire's blood turns black and oily, slow to drink and hard to remove. In open air it ignites, a turn per blood point, three dice aggravated a turn; the vampire is immune to its own fire.
Five successes strip a victim's flesh (to Incapacitated, lethal), then Dexterity + Body Crafts (7) and a blood point seal them in a cocoon. They heal inside and emerge in the shape the vampire chose.

Six blood: a winged, scaled dragon with double Strength and Stamina, 4 armor, five extra Bruised levels, Strength-based Intimidation each turn. Its blood burns in air as Blood of the Earth and can be spat.

An hour and three blood painting glyphs open a portal to the Abyss, a turn per success. Inside, Wits + Obtenebration (6, rising on failures) opens a way out to a place visited before; each try costs a lethal level.

A turn of focus, three blood and an attack (dodge only) on someone in sight drag them into the Abyss for nights equal to Obtenebration, or until a blood point calls them back. Non-Mystics gain a derangement.

After a week of silence, success learns a word that, spoken later, blots out the sky for an hour: vampires ignore sunlight and Rötschreck. After, Road dice at 4; each success keeps Road dots, and Road 0 ends them.
Koldunic power: blood on the earth or water, then the activation roll (the power names the Attribute) + Occult at level + 4.
Koldunic power: blood on the earth or water, then the activation roll (the power names the Attribute) + Occult at level + 4.

Raises a corpse per success to do one simple task until it is done or the corpse is destroyed, slowly rotting; they never defend themselves. Physicals at half Necromancy (round up), no Abilities, four health levels.

Turns a severed hand, eye, head or small dead beast into a cunning familiar that sees and hears for its master and reports by crude telepathy. It stops if more than 100 yards away and lasts a night per success.
Each success lets a blood point raise two corpses that fight on command or follow standing orders as long as the orders last. Another blood point per corpse adds Physical dots equal to Necromancy.
Contested Willpower drives a mortal's (or ghoul's) soul out of the body, which lies comatose, for an hour per net success; it does not work on Cainites or other supernatural beings.

Puts a willing ghost or projected soul into a still-warm corpse or a body emptied by Baleful Exorcism; it uses the body's physical traits and its own mental ones. A dying vampire's body needs five successes.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Cenotaph
powers.e: Touching a person or thing tells whether a ghost touched it or used powers on it: the last turn at one success up to the past week at five. A botch misleads; a ghost found inside is revealed.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Cenotaph
powers.e: After three turns handling an object, learns whether it matters to any ghost; three successes name one such ghost. A botch bars this item for good.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Cenotaph
powers.e: Senses how thin the Shroud is in an area; three successes also tell if it has been tampered with. Once a scene; a botch stuns for a turn and costs a Willpower point.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Cenotaph
powers.e: Always senses when someone within half a mile rises as a ghost. A Willpower point and the roll find it: a vague direction at one success, within a quarter mile at three, to the foot at five.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Cenotaph
powers.e: Vitae on an object (or drunk by a person) and a Willpower point make it a fetter for one ghost the caster names or senses, a night per success (a week per success for another Willpower point).

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: Looks like a mummified corpse until next sunset: Dexterity and Appearance -2, +2 Intimidation dice, and spotting them while still takes five Perception + Medicine successes. Others: touch, vs Stamina + 3.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: A Willpower point: no wound penalties for the scene and a die per Corpse in the Monster dot to resist emotional sway, but manipulating others is 1 harder. Frenzy still threatens.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: A vampire in sight within 20 yards feels every misery of mortal life until sunrise: all actions +2 difficulty (a Willpower point a scene ignores it) and no blood boosts to Physicals.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: For a turn per success: no frenzy or Rötschreck checks, stakes are ordinary wounds, fire deals lethal, holy items do nothing, and sunlight hurts only bare skin on a clear day, as bashing.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: Twelve blood spent without pause give mortal comforts until next midnight: food, warmth, waking by day, and shade or a cloak keeps sunlight off. Frenzy checks are halved, then 3 harder for six nights.
Vitae dripped on a human corpse turns it to unrecognizable ash in five turns minus successes. A botch only rots it, and the power cannot be tried on it again.
Freezes a visible target within 25 yards for a turn per success: no movement or blood spending, though senses and perception powers work. Cainites can still act at a penalty equal to the successes.
A touch on a limb deals two aggravated levels; unless both are soaked, the limb withers until healed (for mortals, for life). A blow to the face costs Appearance and can blind, deafen or mute.

A target in sight within 20 yards resists with Stamina + Fortitude (at the caster's Willpower) or sickens: Strength and Wits halved, Dexterity -1, fed blood may come back up. Contagious among mortals.
Two blood and a Willpower point dripped on a Cainite in reach: each success is an aggravated wound that turns flesh to dust, and every two levels can wither a body part as Ashen Lady's Embrace.
A chant sinks a victim into morbid gloom for a night per success: Social rolls +2 (not Intimidation), others +1. Lasting longer than their Willpower strips Willpower dots; at zero, death or torpor.

A weightless light for the scene that flies as fast as the vampire runs. Mortals who see it roll Willpower (4) or are dazed (+1 to actions); if the caster doubles their successes, they follow it blindly.

Eye contact plants nightmares of their own death: the victim regains no Willpower from that sleep and for the next day has the Nightmares Flaw and feels an Eerie Presence. A botch turns the dreams on the caster.

Shapes chill, voiceless apparitions anywhere in sight: each success adds one phenomenon, or a trait or trigger to a phantom. A botch draws a hostile ghost (the Haunted Flaw for nights equal to the 1s).
Tears the Shroud around a victim: ghosts' powers on them are 1 easier per success (to 4) and hostile ghosts flock to them, the bonus fading by one each dawn. A botch haunts the caster for good.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Sepulchre
powers.e: Sees and hears ghosts, hazy and whispering, for the scene, but cannot touch them; to the dead the necromancer's eyes glow blue. A botch blinds for the scene.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Sepulchre
powers.e: Calls a ghost the caster can name or picture, with something it knew in life at hand (its remains make it 1 easier). It stays in sight until scene's end or dismissed for Willpower. Difficulty 7 or its Willpower.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Sepulchre
powers.e: Holding something the ghost handled in life, vs its Willpower (6 for both): net successes set how many and how risky the orders, or force a true answer. If the ghost wins, the caster loses that much Willpower.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Sepulchre
powers.e: A blood circle ties a named ghost that is present to a place (an object is 1 harder), a night per success; Willpower stretches it to seven nights, a Willpower dot to over a year. Escape tries cost it aggravated levels.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Sepulchre
powers.e: Strikes a ghost's spirit body from the living world, where it cannot strike back: each success is a lethal level. Difficulty the ghost's Willpower, at least 4.
Looks into the Underworld for the scene: its buildings, objects and dead, though nothing there can be touched.
A Willpower point: speaks freely with any ghosts in the area for the scene, seen or not.
A Willpower point: stands on both sides of the Shroud for the scene, touching and touched by ghosts and things of the Underworld while still solid among the living. A blood point a scene extends it.

A door drawn in chalk or blood lets the caster alone walk into the Underworld as a solid ghost, hurt only by what wounds ghosts. Coming back costs a Willpower point and another roll; death there is the end.
Each success raises or lowers ghosts' power difficulties by 1 within half a mile (to 4), fading a point an hour; every 2 points eased also eases other Necromancy by 1.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Twilight Garden
powers.e: Whispers a secret name of Lilith to one target in sight within 100 paces: they roll Willpower (8) or suffer nightmares and visions, -2 dice on all pools, for days equal to the caster's Manipulation.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Twilight Garden
powers.e: Fills the mouth with black bile and vitae: the next bite before dawn does double damage before soak (feeding is no faster).

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Twilight Garden
powers.e: Turns spilled blood into a humor that works on touch: phlegmatic (-2 dice), melancholic (no Willpower spending), sanguine (wounds bleed a level more) or bilious (lethal levels equal to Stamina), for the scene.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Twilight Garden
powers.e: After drinking five blood from a cold corpse, five blood: two more soak dice and no wound penalties for the scene, sees how hurt anyone is, and Perception + Occult (7) shows ghosts to speak with.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Twilight Garden
powers.e: A howl spreads despair five yards per success: those who fail Willpower (7) try to kill themselves for the scene (Cainites fall into torpor), then lose 2 dice until sunrise. Others lose 2 dice for the scene.
Grants the ghostly Deathsight power, seeing the world as the restless dead do.
Blood spent sets a one-yard aura for the scene that ruins nonliving things: a week for one blood, down to a turn for five. Ruined items botch any use; worn clothing and living beings are spared.

A Willpower point lets the vampire feed on death: 1 to 4 points from a fresh death site or graveyard (once a week), or feeding on a ghost like a victim. These points work like blood except for waking at dusk.

Summons a Spectre per success to wreak havoc within half a mile (wider per extra blood); or one target, by touch or a Dexterity + Occult (7) bolt, takes an aggravated level and +2 on Social rolls until sunrise.
A wail hits targets within a yard per Necromancy dot (a Willpower point, plus a blood per extra target): allies get 1 less difficulty per success, or foes take an aggravated level each.
Thaumaturgy path power: one blood point and a Willpower roll at level + 3; effect by successes.

Glides: drifts safely down from any height, and a strong wind can carry it far; more than about 1 kg of load drops it.
Flies at up to 45 km/h with up to 10 kg; anything but a straight line takes Dexterity + Athletics, and Dodge loses two dice in the air.
Flies at up to 60 km/h with up to 25 kg (if Strength allows); only the hardest moves need a roll (difficulty 5), and Dodge is whole.
Flies at up to 90 km/h with up to 50 kg (if Strength allows).
Flies at up to 120 km/h with up to 100 kg (if Strength allows).
A cold flame in the palm (light, no heat, no frenzy); thrown, it burns as fire: soak difficulty 3, 1 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 4, 1 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 5, 2 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 7, 2 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 9, 3 aggravated a turn.
Speeds one mount or walker on the road.
As many as six mounts, or a single loaded wagon.
As many as twelve mounts, or four wagons of supplies.
Up to 24 mounts, eight supply wagons or one siege engine.
Up to 48 mounts, sixteen supply wagons or four siege engines.
Moves an object of up to half a kilogram at a distance.
Up to 10 kg; a held weapon can attack (first turn uses the activation successes, then Melee + Thaumaturgy, Strength = the path's dots).
Up to 100 kg; can lift and fly self or another at running speed (an unwilling target makes opposed Willpower each turn).
Up to 250 kg.
Up to 500 kg.
Fog or light wind (+1 to sight checks, ranges halved) or a small change of temperature.
Rain or snow (+2 to sight checks, ranges halved).
High wind (+2 to ranged attacks, ranges halved, Dexterity at 6 each turn to stay standing) or a larger change of temperature.
Rain and high winds together.
As Storm, and Perception + Occult calls lightning on a target: 10 dice lethal.
Aware of all that happens within 15 meters, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within 100 meters, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within half a kilometer, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within 1.5 kilometers, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within 8 kilometers, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Visions of the target's own damnation: each success takes a die from all the target's pools until a Road roll (difficulty 6, once a night) shakes it off. A Cainite who botches that roll frenzies.

Meeting the eyes and whispering a temptation stirs the target to act on a dark impulse, as strong as the successes. On a Cainite it costs a Willpower point; a Road roll at the infernalist's Willpower resists.
Takes on the look of someone the target loves: one success is a rough likeness, five a perfect one.
Plants the urge to a sin, for a turn, an hour, a night, a week or a month by successes. The target may spend Willpower and roll permanent Willpower (difficulty 6), needing more successes.
Slays a mortal and tears the shadow free as a near-invisible servant for the night: it spies, passes through matter and speaks mind to mind at any distance. It fades at dawn.
No roll: sees nearby spirits, demons and ghosts as if they stood in the flesh. While gazing, all the infernalist's difficulties rise by 1.
Reads what grieves the target most: one success shows whether they feel guilt, five shows their sins, enemies and failings.
Draws one specific memory from the target for each success.
Runestones carved from a new set of a person's bones show the likeliest future: the next moments, a week, a lunar month, a season or a year by successes. Truer for great events than for one person.
Where blood was shed in anger, raises a minor demon in the victim's likeness and wounds that hunts the killer for a day and a night per success.
A touch reopens an old wound: one health level per success, soaked as usual.
The target feels the penalties of one lost health level per success without losing them, even to Incapacitated. Supernatural targets soak with Willpower; healing with blood clears them.
Each success takes one of the target's senses, sight first, for the scene; a vampire spends a blood point to win each back. Or it numbs pain: wound penalties fall by the successes.
Vermin grow in the flesh for a day per success: each day one level from the flies and as many from the maggots as the days so far. Not soaked; blood heals it, but it runs its course.
Festering sores: one aggravated level per success that mortals cannot soak or heal. While they last, the target takes as many soakable levels each time they sleep.
Calls an insignificant demon (Attributes 4/3/2, Abilities 3/2/1, no Disciplines). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a least demon (Attributes 5/4/3, Abilities 4/3/2, 2 points of Disciplines or investments). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a lesser demon (Attributes 6/5/4, Abilities 5/4/3, 4 points). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a minor demon (Attributes 7/6/5, Abilities 6/5/4, 6 points). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a specific demon (a named demon who wants sacrifices and serves only its own ends). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
A small mishap: each success cancels one success on the target's next roll.
A string of accidents for an hour per success: the target ignores the highest die of every roll.
A chant heard wherever the target flees: each success takes a die from their pools while the chanting goes on. On a group, each success costs one listener a die.
Set the difficulty to the target's Stamina. The target can have no children; a vampire can no longer Embrace. Only exorcism, high rituals or the caster's death lift it.

A resisted Willpower roll (difficulty 8) with the target; the loser is cursed for a year: +1 to all difficulties, Appearance 0 and a Minor Curse. A vampire holds it off by spending four more blood each day.
The night winds bring the words of anyone speaking in the open air within a mile; one success is enough.
Stirs vermin to harass: from gathering, to biting one target, an area, chosen targets, or everyone near. Those plagued add 2 to their difficulties.
No roll: drinks a beast's blood and takes its shape until dawn, with its claws or bite; 1 blood for a bird or mouse, 3 for a wolf, 5 or more for a bear. No other Disciplines while masked.
Set the difficulty to the target's Stamina. Spits a coughed-up blood point (Dexterity + Archery in a fight): one aggravated level per success. A botch is three aggravated levels to the strigmaga.
Each success costs a blood point and grows a barbed tentacle: Strength and Dexterity 5, Strength + 2 lethal, 4 health levels; more blood raises a trait by 1. That blood does not come back.
Rides the senses of the animals in range (20 yards to a mile by successes) and does nothing else. After, Wits + Empathy at 10 minus Road or keep their passions; a botch ends in frenzy.
Eye contact steers an animal's will: plain acts at one success, complex tasks at five. It breaks past a mile; a botch brings frenzy.
A touch: each success adds one to the victim's difficulty to resist frenzy. A botch frenzies the caster.
A touch marks the subject's soul for ten years; later Perception + Empathy (6) tells where they are.
Rides a seen target's senses while concentrating (2 less if willing). Successes set which Disciplines work through them: none, Auspex, then Presence, Dominate, Thaumaturgy.
Draws one secret from a seen subject; successes set how clear and how large, a word to a whole tale.
Hears every thought nearby; each success sorts out one clear thought. A botch leaves a derangement until the caster leaves.
Taken instead of a Celerity dot (or 30 XP later). Puts Celerity into a thrown missile: each dot is a level of damage that needs no roll.
Taken instead of a Celerity dot. In melee, Celerity dice cancel a defender's dodge successes for the scene.
Taken instead of a Celerity dot. Runs 5 feet up or 10 feet across per dot on walls or bad ground; over moving water, Dexterity + Athletics.
Moving illusions up to the caster's Willpower, a blood point for each after the first, lasting while the caster concentrates.
A blood point a duplicate of the caster for the scene; steering one is Wits + Subterfuge (6), pool split for more. A botch fades it.
A whole false world for one victim, a turn to a fortnight by successes. Willpower at the caster's pool notices; a Willpower point shatters it.
Touch or eye contact plants hellfire: at the next noon (a day later per success) the victim burns as in sunlight a turn per blood point, soaked only with Fortitude. A botch burns the caster.
Eye contact, resisted by Intelligence + Self-Control (6): the target's mind becomes a copy of the caster's, derangements too, a night to a year.
Words that plant a derangement and its trigger (1 harder if hidden in talk): one success, a year; two or more, for good.
Stops or starts one body function (heartbeat, breath, sight, hearing) for a turn per success; above 10 it cannot work. A vampire's heart does not matter.
With Murmur of the False Will on a crowd's most stubborn: each extra success carries the command to one more. If the first resists, none obey.
Works Dominate through a puppet ruler, who may never know; a roll for each new power used through them.
Taken instead of the next Fortitude dot. Struck by an object, roll Fortitude (7): equal to or more than the damage successes and the weapon shatters; otherwise soak as usual.
Taken instead of a Fortitude dot. A blood point per Fortitude dot given (up to the caster's own), drunk by the subject, for a turn to a chapter by successes.
Taken instead of a Fortitude dot. Stays awake by day (a turn to all day by successes) with pools up to Road + Willpower, or a blood point to wake at once.
A corpse a blood point rises for a turn per success: living Physicals, Mentals 1, one more health level, no wound penalties, gone at Incapacitated.
Feels any death within 50 yards, from the bare fact to every detail by successes; on the living (at their Willpower) it tells how near their death is.
A touch spreads a sickness to victims up to the caster's Willpower: each rolls Stamina (+Fortitude) at the caster's Stamina + Occult or dies within an hour; vampires fall to torpor.
An image of the caster a yard to 30 yards off draws every eye; other actions are 1 harder. Touching the world calls for contested Perception + Alertness.
Hides ten people per Stealth dot with no roll; shouting or a fight inside calls for Wits + Stealth. Leaving it, successes set how far, 10 to 2000 yards.
Seen as the one person the subject would tell anything; more successes, a better likeness.
Shadow wraps a victim: a mortal loses a blood point a turn, all at +3 difficulty; a Cainite fights fear (Courage 8). The caster takes back half the blood.
Wakes a subject's shadow for an hour per success: half their traits, Stealth 5, half the caster's Obtenebration. If it dies, the caster loses half their Willpower.
Up to three shadow servants from the caster's own shadow, a Willpower point and five blood points each, until dawn: no wound penalties, a cold touch that does aggravated harm.
Taken instead of a Potence dot. Brawls at a range in yards up to Potence, rolled as a ranged attack; the damage is Potence, rolled.
Taken instead of a Potence dot. Shapes a weapon by hand: a die of damage per two successes (up to 3) and it deals aggravated harm.
Taken instead of a Potence dot. A touch lands the full blow: Potence levels of damage; things cannot resist, the living soak as usual.
Floods a Cainite with mortal feelings: from nostalgia to -5 dice in ecstasy, or senseless at five. Harder by one per Road dot below 5.
Guilt drives one victim to their knees: a turn per success, whispering their sins; it even stills a frenzy.
Fires up troops: 2 to 20 mortals by successes (everyone in sight at five) ignore wound penalties to Crippled and pass every Courage roll.
Sinks into the earth and moves through it as through water, by day too; a hunt below is contested Wits + Athletics.
A man-wolf over eight feet tall in three turns: Physicals +3, Socials 1, Strength + 2 aggravated claws, a Hurt level more, keen senses.
Hurls a stake or other object out of the body.
After feeding on a mortal, each success makes one blood point count as two (the pool's limit still holds).
A touch locks blood points equal to the successes, for as many turns. Works on ghouls, not on mortals. Harder by the target's Fortitude.
A cut and a touch plant blood that turns to asps when called, within three nights: a health level a blood point, soaked only with Fortitude.
A touch makes the victim a python for a scene to a year, Intelligence 1. Back in human shape, Wits + Empathy (6) or a lasting fear of snakes.
A serpent-man in three turns: Strength and Stamina +2, Dexterity +3, Appearance 0, crushing tail, Strength + 2 aggravated bite, a soak die more. Two blood a night to keep.
Grafts dead parts onto one living host to make a guardian that lives an hour to a year by successes.
A touch turns body parts to blood, a blood point a success (target's Stamina 6 cancels one each). Head or torso kills a mortal; a vampire regrows each part with blood.
Fleshcrafts at range: the successes are the dice the caster may use on the Vicissitude roll.
Cows another creature's Beast into grudging obedience, 5 to 8 by its power; it obeys until the Laibon relaxes. A botch is Rotschreck.
Writes the name of an ancient beast; it comes within a scene, unbound, and must be appeased.
Takes a soul into the caster's own to heal it: a permanent Willpower point restores a Road dot. Difficulty 12 minus Road; not on Road 1 or the Via Diabolis.
Pain that goes on after the touch, a scene a success; a level of harm a blood point if wished, and frenzy (Willpower 6) once past the target's Willpower.
After Purification, thrusts the evil spirit into a thing, beast or person in reach; a living host may cost a Road roll.
Hardens a thing for a turn per success: a shield or door resists one more health level per success; a weapon gains a die of damage per two successes.
Each success hardens one blood point's measure of liquid (roughly two pints), at its own heat; spilled blood or boiling oil alike. Solid blood cannot be drunk.
Melts three pounds of metal, wood or stone a success: a coin, an arrow, a knife, a sword, a shield. It sets again as a useless lump.
A cubic foot of air a success turns to ice around a foe, a prison that holds until it ends.
Three pounds of solid a success turn to vapor. When it sets again, those nearby roll Dexterity + Athletics (6) or take a level; a botch traps them, aggravated.
A small shock by touch or through metal or water: two dice of damage. Successes set the gathering time: a minute at one, two turns at three, at once at five.
Lightning wreathes the arm and lights a room; a touch does four dice of damage.
The whole body sheathed in sparks: six dice of damage by touch or through a conductor.
A sheath of lightning that does eight dice of damage to what it touches.
A blinding aura: ten dice of damage by touch, and all who look at the caster lose a die and cannot Dominate them.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: Fear roots a seen victim: each success takes a die from their pools; at none left they cannot act.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: One to ten people by successes flee the caster's gaze unless their Courage (at the caster's Willpower) beats the successes.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: A vision of damnation: the victim cowers for a turn to a night by successes, acting only with Courage (7) above the successes.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: Shows the victim their deepest dread; more successes, deeper and longer, at five enough to break their mind.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: Horrors seen by two to twenty people by successes, from halting to fainting; at five, Courage (8) or lose a permanent Willpower point.
A blood sigil on a door: it opens only to Strength of twice the successes, and the caster knows when it does.
A glyph to see and hear through for a day per success, one at a time, at +2 difficulty while watching.
Runes on a thing deal an aggravated level per success to anyone but the caster who touches it (Fortitude soaks), until sunlight or ruin.
As Glyph of Scrying (Willpower 7), but the caster may speak and send other Thaumaturgy through it, a day off for each.
A glyph at a building's exact centre seals every door, window and breach until dawn (Willpower 8); they can still be broken.
